title:
Triggered on `MODAL_CLOSE` action of `Reliability.AdditionalSensorSelectionModal`.

The epic does the following:
-- 1. Resets `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsForm`.
-- 2. For `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsGrid`.
       - Cancels any in-flight data requests.
       - Resets all selections.
       - Clears component data for.
name: ClearAdditionalSensorSelectionModalEpic
